podcast.title: Attending Cinema with Elvis
podcast.body: Bob Montgomery frequently reminisced about going to the cinema with Elvis, such as to watch "Gentlemen Prefer Blondes," where Elvis often became bored and left the film halfway through with the rest of the group. "Bob Montgomery used to reminisce about going to the cinema with Elvis to watch gentlemen for Fifir Blondes, and Elvis getting bored with the film Half an Hour in, and leaving with the rest of the group."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Buddy and Bob Duo
podcast.body: Bob Montgomery performed with Buddy Holly as "Buddy and Bob," playing pure country and western music, with Montgomery on guitar and Holly on mandolin. "By his mid-teens, he was performing as Buddy and Bob, with a friend Bob Montgomery playing pure country and western music, with Buddy on the mandolin while Bob played guitar."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Early Vocalist for Holly's Demos
podcast.body: Montgomery often sang the lead vocals on Buddy Holly's early demos, including those recorded with Sonny Curtis, before Holly established himself as the primary vocalist. "He had already been recording demos with Bob and Sonny Curtis, usually with Bob on vocals."
